premises.text: Breaches are inevitable, so encryption is needed, but existing cloud DB encryption options trade off usability, query support, or true secrecy
premises.evidence_span: it's no longer a question of whether a breach will occur, but rather what the cost of this breach will be

premises.text: A never-decrypt cloud database keeps data encrypted at rest, in transit, and in memory while still supporting private search and queries without app changes
premises.evidence_span: the first never decrypt cloud database solution

premises.text: Go-to-market is direct financial-services and cloud-native deals plus database providers as channel partners
premises.evidence_span: working with direct engagements with financial services, medium-sized, cloud-native companies, and also database providers as channel partners
